messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Using STAN on very tall and wide data
parts:
That's a pretty broad request! What specifically are
you trying to do?

Stan can encode a lot of the models popular in machine
learning. Although it scales reasonably well, it isn't
going to compete with large custom implementations.

There are no sparse data types built in (though see the
manual description of LDA for how to encode them).

There are no online algorithms yet, but Andrew's very
keen on developing and implementing them, so expect to
see more scalable methods, including online (data partitioning)
methods in six months to a year's time.

- Bob
